title: Liquid Web Review 2026: Managed WordPress, Nexcess and Pricing
excerpt: A Liquid Web review covering the Nexcess merger, managed WordPress prices, a Website Planet speed test, pros and cons.

meta._yoast_wpseo_title: Liquid Web Review 2026: Managed WordPress Prices
meta._yoast_wpseo_metadesc: Liquid Web review for 2026: managed WordPress prices, the Nexcess merger, a Website Planet speed test, support, pros and cons, and who it suits.
meta.rl_answer: Liquid Web is a managed host for busy sites. Pro WordPress starts at $19 a month, and Nexcess is now part of Liquid Web.
meta.rl_faqs:
Is Liquid Web good? | Website Planet saw no downtime in a one-week test of the entry plan. The test was short.
Is Nexcess the same as Liquid Web? | TechRadar said Nexcess is now fully absorbed into Liquid Web.
How much does Liquid Web managed WordPress cost? | Pro WordPress starts at $19 a month for 50,000 visits. Elite starts at $29 a month.
Does Liquid Web have a money-back guarantee? | The managed WordPress page we read did not show one. Check the live terms.
Does Liquid Web have AI features? | The page we read did not list any.
meta.rl_sources:
Liquid Web: managed WordPress hosting (read 15 and 16 Nov 2026) | https://www.liquidweb.com/wordpress-hosting/managed-wordpress/
Website Planet: Liquid Web (formerly Nexcess) review | https://www.websiteplanet.com/web-hosting/nexcess/
meta.rl_takeaways:
Pro WordPress starts at $19 a month for 50,000 visits.
Nexcess is now part of Liquid Web, per TechRadar.
Website Planet saw no downtime in a one-week test.
The page we read lists no money-back guarantee and no AI features.
meta.rl_g_glossary:
Managed WordPress | Hosting where the host handles updates, backups and security.
Staging | A private copy of your site for testing changes.
Object cache | Memory that stores database results to speed up pages.
SLA | A promise about service levels.
